def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # key -> value
    write_time = {}  # key -> time when written
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k in cache if write_time[k] + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del write_time[k]
            
            # If key not present and cache is full, evict LRU
            if key not in cache and len(cache) >= capacity:
                lru_key = next(iter(cache))
                del cache[lru_key]
                del write_time[lru_key]
            
            # Put the new entry
            cache[key] = value
            write_time[key] = t
            
            # Move to end (most recently used)
            cache.move_to_end(key)
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k in cache if write_time[k] + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del write_time[k]
            
            # Get the value
            if key in cache:
                results.append(cache[key])
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                cache.move_to_end(key)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
